result_summary.title: Critical: SSO Redirect Loop and missing password reset emails in APAC Staging
result_summary.description: Our staging environment in APAC is currently unusable due to a critical SSO failure. Users are caught in an infinite redirect loop when trying to log in. Furthermore, those attempting to bypass the loop via 'forgot password' are not receiving reset emails. This is blocking the entire QA team (approx. 11,600 test users/stakeholders) and preventing us from releasing to production. Immediate assistance required.
